basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow post at ICAR-Indian Institute of Millets Research is on 16 November 2026 from 10:30 A.M onwards, at the Regional Research Station (RRS) on Pearl Millet, Gudamalani, Balotra, Rajasthan—344031. The reporting time is till 10:15 AM with a grace period of 15 mins. One Senior Research Fellow (Plant Breeding/ Plant Genetic Resources) position is offered purely on contractual basis at Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month, under the project "Distinctness Uniformity & Stability Test (PPV & FRA)".

age_limit.details: Maximum age is 35 years for Senior Research Fellow. The application format asks for age as on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-IIMR Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee or a separate last date to apply; candidates simply attend on the walk-in date.

rows.details: Interview from 10:30 A.M onwards; reporting till 10:15 AM with a grace period of 15 mins
ICAR-Indian Institute of Millets Research (Shree Anna), Regional Research Station (RRS) on Pearl Millet, Gudamalani, Balotra, Rajasthan—344031
Senior Research Fellow (Plant Breeding/ Plant Genetic Resources)
Candidates with the essential qualifications, maximum age 35 years (with relaxation)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: ICAR – Indian Institute of Millets Research is described on its letterhead as the Global Centre of Excellence on Millets (Shree Anna), at Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030. This post is at its Regional Research Station on Pearl Millet in Gudamalani, Balotra, Rajasthan, and is attached to the project "Distinctness Uniformity & Stability Test (PPV & FRA)".

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: M. Sc (Ag). in Genetics & Plant Breeding / Genetics & Cytogenetics / Horticulture / Plant Pathology / Plant Genetic Resources, OR M.Sc. in Botany / Genetics / M. Sc. in Agricultural Biotechnology / Plant Science, with 1st Division or 60% marks or equivalent OGPA. Candidates having a PG degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification. Candidates may ensure their eligibility as per ICAR memorandum F. No. Ag. Edn.6/27/2014-HRD dated 30th July 2019 before applying. Research experience with Pearl Millet/Millets/field crops; design, layout and handling of field experiments, selfing and crossing techniques, field evaluation, data recording and analysis using statistical software. Experience in DUS characterization in field crops etc. Relevant certificates for essential and desirable qualifications are compulsory. Only candidates having essential qualifications will be allowed to attend the interview. Maximum age is 35 years for Senior Research Fellow. The application format asks for age as on the date of interview.

rows.post: Senior Research Fellow (Plant Breeding/ Plant Genetic Resources)
rows.qualification: M.Sc. in the listed disciplines with 1st Division or 60% marks or equivalent OGPA (details below)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Emoluments: Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month. The post is purely temporary and on contractual basis till the expiry of the project. Tenure is till 31.03.2027 and further extendable based on performance of the candidate and availability of funds under the project. Selected candidates shall not claim regular appointment/absorption in ICAR-IIMR, Hyderabad or the funding agency at the end of the project. The selected candidate may have to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the format of Annexure - I, with a photograph affixed and signed. A duly filled in application form is compulsory. Annexure - II declaration about relatives employed in ICAR-IIMR (either that none is employed, or the particulars of relatives working in ICAR). All relevant original testimonials (date of birth, degree certificate, experience certificate, etc., if any) to be shown. A set of attested copies of all certificates, for verification at registration and before joining, if selected. Self-attested certificates and mark sheets from class 10th onwards, and experience certificates. No objection certificate from the current employer, if employed.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report for registration, where original certificates are shown and attested copies are submitted, and then attend the walk-in interview. The reporting time is till 10:15 AM with a grace period of 15 mins, and applications of candidates reporting after the prescribed time will not be accepted. The decision of the Head RRS on Pearl Millet is final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026 at 10:30 A.M onwards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the ICAR-IIMR walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Reporting is till 10:15 AM with a grace period of 15 mins. Applications of candidates reporting after the prescribed time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the ICAR-IIMR walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at ICAR-IIMR Regional Research Station (RRS) on Pearl Millet, Gudamalani, Balotra, Rajasthan—344031.

faq.question: Q4. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are vacant at ICAR-IIMR?
faq.answer: One position is offered for Senior Research Fellow (Plant Breeding/ Plant Genetic Resources).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the ICAR-IIMR SRF post?
faq.answer: M.Sc. (Ag.) in Genetics & Plant Breeding / Genetics & Cytogenetics / Horticulture / Plant Pathology / Plant Genetic Resources, OR M.Sc. in Botany / Genetics / Agricultural Biotechnology / Plant Science, with 1st Division or 60% marks or equivalent OGPA. A PG in Basic Sciences with 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree needs NET.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age for the ICAR-IIMR SRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, with a relaxation of five years for SC/ST and women, three years for OBC, and relaxation as per GOI rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of the ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the ICAR-IIMR walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled Annexure - I and Annexure - II with a signed photograph, original testimonials, a set of attested copies, self-attested certificates and mark sheets from class 10th onwards, experience certificates, and a no objection certificate if employed.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and on contractual basis till the expiry of the project, with tenure till 31.03.2027, extendable based on performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the ICAR-IIMR interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no TA/DA or any other expenses will be paid for attending the interview.
